about: The first Azure storage shapes. A JMESPath key `logging.read && logging.write && logging.delete` compared equal to false flags an account when any one of the three is off, not only when all are; and a remediation can be a `ReadOnly` lock on the whole account, which an agent must hear about. The collection it came from read both right in every run; this guards them.

says: \b(any|either|one|at least one) (one )?(of )?(the three|read|those)\b|\bnot all\b|\b(any|one or more)\b(?:[^.;]|\.(?=\w)){0,100}\b(off|disabled|false|missing)\b|\bnot (be )?(enabled|on|logged) for all\b|\bdo(es)? not have\b[^.;]{0,60}\ball\b|\bread, write,? or delete\b[^.;]{0,60}\b(off|disabled|not enabled|turned off)\b|\bin any combination\b|\b(covers|covering|logs?|logging) all three\b

controls.output:
- Storage accounts where any of read, write or delete logging is off for blobs are flagged; accounts logging all three pass. LOW; scheduled scan; one policy reports, the other turns all three on with 90-day retention. acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1, acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1
- Storage accounts with `allowSharedKeyAccess` true are flagged; accounts with it false pass. HIGH; scheduled scan; one policy reports, the other puts a ReadOnly lock on the account. acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1, acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1

- Blob services where any of `logging.read`, `logging.write` or `logging.delete` is off are flagged. LOW; scheduled scan; one reports, the other turns logging on. acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1, acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1
- Storage accounts with `allowSharedKeyAccess` true are flagged. HIGH; scheduled scan; one reports, the other puts a ReadOnly lock on the account. acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1, acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1

- Blob storage with read, write or delete logging off is flagged; blob storage logging all three passes. LOW; scheduled scan; one reports, the other turns logging on. acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1, acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1
- Storage accounts with `allowSharedKeyAccess` true are flagged. HIGH; scheduled scan; one reports, the other puts a ReadOnly lock on the account. acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1, acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1

- Storage accounts where blob logging is not enabled for all of read, write and delete are flagged. LOW; scheduled scan; one reports, the other turns logging on. acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1, acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1
- Storage accounts with `allowSharedKeyAccess` true are flagged. HIGH; scheduled scan; one reports, the other applies a ReadOnly lock to the account. acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1, acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1

- Blob storage whose diagnostic settings do not have read, write and delete logging all enabled is flagged. LOW; scheduled scan; one reports, the other turns logging on. acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1, acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1
- Storage accounts with `allowSharedKeyAccess` true are flagged. HIGH; scheduled scan; one reports, the other puts a ReadOnly lock on the account. acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1, acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1

- Storage accounts with read, write and delete blob logging all disabled are flagged. LOW; scheduled scan; one reports, the other turns logging on. acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1, acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1
- Storage accounts with `allowSharedKeyAccess` true are flagged. HIGH; scheduled scan; one reports, the other locks the account read-only. acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1, acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1

- Storage accounts where any of read, write or delete blob logging is off are flagged. LOW; scheduled scan; one reports, the other turns logging on. acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1, acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1
- Storage accounts with `allowSharedKeyAccess` true are flagged. HIGH; scheduled scan; one reports, the other remediates the account. acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1, acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1

- Storage accounts with `properties.allowSharedKeyAccess` set to true are flagged, and accounts where it is false or not set to true pass. HIGH, no compliance framework; runs on a scheduled pull scan whose timing the platform sets; `acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1` only reports, while `acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1` applies an Azure `ReadOnly` lock to the flagged account, which blocks changes to the account, including changing this setting, until the lock is removed. acme:storage-shared-key-inform@1, acme:storage-shared-key-lock@1
- Blob storage accounts whose diagnostic settings do not log `read`, `write` and `delete` operations are flagged, and blob logging that covers all three passes whatever its retention. LOW, no compliance framework; runs on a scheduled pull scan whose timing the platform sets; `acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1` only reports, while `acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1` turns on read, write and delete logging for blob storage with a retention of 90 days. acme:storage-blob-logging-inform@1, acme:storage-blob-logging-enable@1
